items.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: Harry recommended us to the people that were interested in sending the group.

ctx.x: Well, tell me a little bit about this Vienna trip. How did that come about?

Well, our trip to Vienna was primarily... A result of... Harry Sushant's... Interest in the group. Some people from New Orleans were interested... Of course, in having a Dixieland group at the festival. More or less as a counter... Effect against the... Communist... Interests. And they realized, of course, that Dixieland in Europe is... Or let's say jazz in Europe is a terrific attraction. And they wanted something that was truly New Orleans. And young at the same time. A youthful group that would fit in with the…
They treated you nice in Vienna, those communist times.
